groups.title: MMPR Season 1 Rangers
groups.def: The five original teenagers with attitude who first morphed into Mighty Morphin Power Rangers in Season 1.

groups.title: Zeo Rangers
groups.def: Everyone who wore a Zeo Ranger suit, including both Gold Zeo Rangers.

groups.title: Ninja Storm Rangers
groups.def: Everyone who morphed into a Wind, Thunder, or Samurai Ranger on the Ninja Storm team.

groups.title: Dino Thunder Rangers
groups.def: Everyone who morphed into a Dino Ranger, including the mentor who joined as Black Ranger.

groups.title: S.P.D. Rangers
groups.def: Everyone who morphed into an S.P.D. Ranger, B-Squad or otherwise.

groups.title: Mystic Force Rangers
groups.def: Everyone who morphed into a Mystic Force Ranger.

groups.title: Operation Overdrive Rangers
groups.def: Everyone who morphed into an Operation Overdrive Ranger.

groups.title: Jungle Fury Rangers
groups.def: Everyone who morphed into a Jungle Fury Ranger.

groups.title: RPM Rangers
groups.def: Everyone who morphed into an RPM Ranger (their scientist ally Dr. K never suits up herself).

groups.title: Red Rangers
groups.def: Every ranger covered here who has morphed as a Red Ranger, even briefly or as a mid-season promotion.

groups.title: Blue Rangers
groups.def: Every ranger covered here who has morphed as a Blue Ranger, even briefly.

groups.title: Yellow Rangers
groups.def: Every ranger covered here who has morphed as a Yellow Ranger.

groups.title: Pink Rangers
groups.def: Every ranger covered here who has morphed as a Pink Ranger.

groups.title: Black Rangers
groups.def: Every ranger covered here who has morphed as a Black Ranger.

groups.title: Rita and Zedd's palace
groups.def: The villains based in Rita and/or Zedd's palace on the Moon across Mighty Morphin, including the Alien Rangers arc.

groups.title: The Machine Empire
groups.def: King Mondo's robotic family and commanders, the main villains of Power Rangers Zeo.

groups.title: Lothor's forces
groups.def: Lothor and the named generals of his army in Ninja Storm.

groups.title: Green Rangers
groups.def: Every ranger covered here who has morphed as a Green Ranger, even briefly.

groups.title: White Rangers
groups.def: Every ranger covered here who has morphed as a White Ranger.

groups.title: Gold Rangers
groups.def: Every ranger covered here who has morphed as a Gold Ranger.

groups.title: Mentors who never morphed
groups.def: Allies who train or guide a team from behind the scenes across these seasons but are never seen morphing into a Ranger themselves.

groups.title: Troobian Empire
groups.def: The named commanders of the Troobian Empire, the main villains of Power Rangers S.P.D.

groups.title: Mystic Force villains
groups.def: The named villains from the Underworld that the Mystic Force Rangers fight, including ones later redeemed.

groups.title: Operation Overdrive villains
groups.def: The named villains hunting the same jewels as the Operation Overdrive Rangers.

groups.title: The Dai Shi Clan
groups.def: Named members of the Dai Shi Clan/Order of the Claw in Jungle Fury, including two later redeemed and restored to human form.

groups.title: Venjix's network
groups.def: The named villains of the Venjix computer network in RPM, including one who later defects to help the Rangers.
